instruction.title: Instruction
instruction.description: The edit, in free-form text. It is expanded into a VGL, which is returned. With 'vgl', the change to make to it. 'prompt' is accepted as an alias.

vgl.description: A VGL (Visual Generation Language) document. Alone, it is the edit as-is and must carry its 'edit_instruction'. With 'instruction', it is the first image's VGL, the baseline the edit is written from. Accepts what a previous request returned.

sync_mode.title: Sync Mode
sync_mode.description: If true, returns the image directly in the response (increases latency).

aspect_ratio.title: Aspect Ratio
aspect_ratio.description: Output aspect ratio, at about one megapixel. Left unset, the output keeps the ratio of the first image. A single image always keeps its own ratio.

image_urls.title: Image Urls
image_urls.description: 1-4 images to edit (files or URLs). The instruction refers to them as ,  and so on, in the order they are sent.

mask_url.title: Mask Url
mask_url.description: Mask (file or URL) marking the region to regenerate: white where the model should edit, black elsewhere. Single-image requests only, at that image's size. A masked edit comes back at the image's own size, with its own pixels outside the mask.

file_name.title: File Name
file_name.description: The name of the file. It will be auto-generated if not provided.

file_size.title: File Size
file_size.description: The size of the file in bytes.

width.title: Width
width.description: The width of the image in pixels.

url.title: Url
url.description: The URL where the file can be downloaded from.

height.title: Height
height.description: The height of the image in pixels.

content_type.title: Content Type
content_type.description: The mime type of the file.
